tagline: 8-voice wavetable synth with 32 tables and an enveloped filter
description: An 8-voice synth that reads from 32 built-in single-cycle wavetables, from sine and saw to formant, bell and noise. One Position control moves through the tables, crossfading between neighbours, into a multi-mode filter with its own envelope and an amp envelope.

features.name: 32 wavetables
features.description: Basic waves, harmonic series, pulses, saw variants, digital, formant, vowel, bell, glass, organ, noise, chip and pad tables, generated in code

features.name: Wavetable Position
features.description: 0 to 1 across all 32 tables, interpolating between the two nearest

features.name: Multi-mode filter
features.description: Low-pass, high-pass, band-pass or notch; cutoff 20 Hz to 20 kHz, resonance 0.5 to 10

features.name: Filter envelope
features.description: Its own ADSR, adding up to 10 kHz to the cutoff, scaled by Env Amount

features.name: Amp envelope and velocity
features.description: ADSR with attack and decay up to 2 s and release up to 5 s; velocity sets the note level

features.name: 8-voice polyphony
features.description: Eight voices through the shared AudioForge voice manager

useCases: Pads - a soft table with slow attack and release
Leads - a bright table with a resonant low-pass and a short filter envelope
Bass - a saw or pulse table with the cutoff low and a snappy filter envelope
Exploring timbre - sweep Position while holding a note
